dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Been on a shopping spree, then?

dialogues.speaker: Ixkotii
dialogues.text: How could I not? I thought that applying to leave Natlan on the grounds of making money was never going to work, but the chief approved my request without delay.

dialogues.speaker: Ixkotii
dialogues.text: As expected, making Liyue Harbor — with its thriving commercial sector and abundant goods — my first port of call was the right choice.

dialogues.speaker: Ixkotii
dialogues.text: Rather than selling my own wares, I'm now far more interested in picking up as much as I can to take home with me when I leave.
